notes: Read pages 1-28 of 28. Modified cash basis, governmental funds only (no business-type funds; school nutrition and activities are in Other Governmental Funds). Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (p5); inter-fund transfers net to zero there (General transfers 27,001.01 in / 40,000 out, Other 40,000 in / 27,001.01 out, reclassification column eliminates them), so top-level transfers are null. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance / net position 8,431,356.10; ending cash = total cash 10,539,667.36. Statement of Net Position (p1) has no liabilities. Debt service 397,700 split into principal 380,000 and interest+fees 17,700 using Bond Fund schedule (p16). Non-revenue receipts 198,710.97 split into insurance adjustments, sale of property and other non-revenue per Exhibit G (p9). FIX PASS (attempt 2): (1) 'Other (taxes)' 5,855,055.58 now split using the fund schedules (carline 13,290.96 + homestead 204,284.42 + property tax credit 5,608,224.98 + pro rate motor vehicle 29,255.22; General p8 + Bond p16 + Special Building p17; General part 5,708,853.28 and Other Governmental part 146,202.30 agree with Exhibit D p5). (2) Student transportation: the 81,250 reclassification (p7) comes out of the group Student transportation - regular (2710 608,367.76 + 2730 91,471.03 = 699,838.79 vs 618,588.79 on Exhibit D); the page does not name the line, so 2710 and 2730 are restored as printed and a negative contra expenditure line (-81,250) plus a -81,250 other financing line carry the transfer to the Depreciation Fund (which prints Fund transfers in 81,250 on p12).
